newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler raises incentives for Dodge models.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler raises incentives for Dodge models.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said Thursday it is increasing incentives on certain 1996 and 1997 car models by $500.
The changes are effective November 15 and extend through January 6. The program gives new car buyers the choice of cash allowances or reduced interest rates on financing.
Chrysler said it raised the allowances on its 1996 Dodge Avenger, Chrysler Sebring Coupe and Eagle Talon by $500 to $1,500.

It raised the allowances on 1997 Dodge Avenger, Chrysler Sebring Coupe and Eagle Talon by $500 to $1,000, and also raised incentives on its 1997 Dodge Intrepid, Chrysler Concorde LX and Eagle Vision ESi by $500 to $1,000.
The incentives on 1997 Dodge Intrepid ES, Chrysler Concorde LXi, and Eagle Vision TSi were raised by $500 to $1,500.

Cash allowances available to buyers of other vehicles covered by the program were unchanged. The lower annual percentage rate financing available as an alternative to cash allowances were unchanged, Chrysler said.
